selector_oracle_witness.statement: theorem selector_oracle_witness : ∃ (J Jhat : Bool → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (ahat : Bool), 0 ≤ ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧ (∀ a, 0 < J a) ∧ (∀ a, |Jhat a - J a| ≤ ε * J a) ∧ (∀ a, Jhat a ≤ Jhat ahat)

selector_variance_regret_witness.statement: theorem selector_variance_regret_witness : ∃ (J Jhat : Bool → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (ahat : Bool), 0 ≤ ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧ (∀ a, 0 < J a) ∧ (∀ a, |Jhat a - J a| ≤ ε * J a) ∧ (∀ a, Jhat a ≤ Jhat ahat)

selector_oracle_bias_noise_witness.statement: theorem selector_oracle_bias_noise_witness : ∃ (J Jdelta Jhat : Bool → ℝ) (εb εn : ℝ) (ahat : Bool), 0 ≤ εb ∧ 0 ≤ εn ∧ εn ≤ 1 ∧ (∀ a, 0 < J a) ∧ (∀ a, |Jdelta a - J a| ≤ εb * J a) ∧ (∀ a, |Jhat a - Jdelta a| ≤ εn * Jdelta a) ∧ (∀ a, Jhat a ≤ Jhat ahat)

selector_additive_witness.statement: theorem selector_additive_witness : ∃ (J Jhat : Bool → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (ahat : Bool), (∀ a, |Jhat a - J a| ≤ η) ∧ (∀ a, Jhat a ≤ Jhat ahat)

selector_consistent_witness.statement: theorem selector_consistent_witness : ∃ (Jlim Jhat : Bool → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (alim ahat : Bool), (∀ a, |Jhat a - Jlim a| ≤ η) ∧ (∀ a, a ≠ alim → Jlim a + 2 * η < Jlim alim) ∧ (∀ a, Jhat a ≤ Jhat ahat)

selector_regret_of_biased_limit_witness.statement: theorem selector_regret_of_biased_limit_witness : ∃ (V Jlim Jhat : Bool → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (alim ahat abest : Bool), (∀ a, |Jhat a - Jlim a| ≤ η) ∧ (∀ a, a ≠ alim → Jlim a + 2 * η < Jlim alim) ∧ (∀ a, Jhat a ≤ Jhat ahat) ∧ V abest < V alim

one_step_pilot_share_witness.statement: theorem one_step_pilot_share_witness : ∃ (s c' : ℝ), s ≠ 0 ∧ c' ≠ 0

misweighted_variance_bound_witness.statement: theorem misweighted_variance_bound_witness : ∃ F : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ, F.PosDef
